initial_state.tagline: A simulated marketplace of invented makers. No maker is paid and nothing ships.

et-mug-slab.title: Slab-built Stoneware Mug, Harbour Glaze
et-mug-slab.description: Thrown, trimmed and glazed in a garage in West Seattle. The glaze breaks blue over the throwing rings.

et-scarf-loom.title: Hand-loomed Lambswool Scarf, Fog Grey
et-scarf-loom.description: Two weeks on the loom for a run of six. The grey has a thread of oxblood every fortieth pick.

et-print-map.title: Letterpress Map Print, Puget Sound
et-print-map.description: Set in metal type and pulled on a Vandercook. The plate for the coastline took three attempts.

et-ring-band.title: Hammered Band, Recycled Silver
et-ring-band.description: Each band is forged from reclaimed silver and hammered cold, so the facets catch light differently all the way round.

et-notebook.title: Coptic-bound Notebook, 160 Pages
et-notebook.description: Sewn by hand so it opens flat on a desk without being broken in first.

et-tote-block.title: Block-printed Tote, Fern
et-tote-block.description: Carved, inked and pulled one at a time. Sold out while the next block dries.

search_entries.snippet: Ceramics, textiles, paper and jewelry from invented makers. Favourite a listing or message the seller.
